shown.message:
I opened `paper-repo`#9. At `dev` 54b193d, the main text runs about half a page past the 9-page NeurIPS 2026 limit.

- **Cause:** I read this from the `document` branch build, which is 24 pages. The References heading is on page 10, and the "Discussion and limits" section and "Code and data" paragraph come before it on that page. The additions for the second matrix pushed the text over. At `cfe8a3c`, the head I approved, it was within the limit.
- **Why it matters:** a submission over the limit is not reviewed.
- **Request:** I asked `paper-repo` to cut or move material to the appendix before the next candidate. I also noted that Tables 2b and 4 together with the existing tables and figures may exceed my ceiling of 7 figures and tables in the main text.
- **Next:** I will recheck the page count at the next head I'm asked to review.

The Outline revision doesn't change my budget. `paper-repo`#7 (`main` into `release`) is waiting on `internal-review-repo`, not on me.
